recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑（右側粉紅色）旁的骨髓腔被單調密集的母細胞完全填滿，核圓或有凹痕、染色質細緻、細胞質少，散在多個核分裂像，看不到正常脂肪與三系造血；是急性淋巴母細胞白血病的骨髓取代型態。
features: Packed marrow with complete replacement of intertrabecular space by blasts; bony trabecula at right
Monotonous small-to-medium cells with high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm
Round to irregular or indented nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
No fat, megakaryocytes or maturing myeloid/erythroid elements identified
describe_en: H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a 100% cellular marrow in which the intertrabecular space is replaced by sheets of monotonous small-to-medium blasts, abutting a bony trabecula on the right. The blasts have scant cytoplasm, round to irregular or indented nuclei, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and numerous mitotic figures are present. Fat, megakaryocytes and maturing hematopoietic elements are not identified. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by acute lymphoblastic leukemia; B-lineage and the BCR::ABL1-like subtype are established by flow cytometry and genetic testing.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts typically show more cytoplasm, prominent nucleoli and MPO/CD117 positivity.
Medium cells with multiple nucleoli, squared cytoplasmic borders, starry-sky macrophages and TdT negativity with MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumors (neuroblastoma, Ewing sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Often form clusters/rosettes and are CD45-negative with lineage markers such as PHOX2B, CD99/NKX2-2 or myogenin; note Ewing and B-ALL can both be CD99+ and TdT is key.
